# Kerem Özdemir

> Sustainability and economics, Munich. Products, instruments, case studies, simulations and games that run in the browser, free, no account. English, Turkish and German.

Everything here is static and runs on the page; nothing is uploaded and no third party is called.

## Products (https://keremozdemir.de/projects/)
- [plsfix](https://keremozdemir.de/projects/plsfix/): Drop the files, say as little as you like, and get back what a consultant would produce, every figure naming the rows it came from
- [Frons](https://keremozdemir.de/projects/frons/): Every photo of one person in an event set of thousands, from one selfie, without the face ever leaving their device
- [LiveOps economy engine](https://keremozdemir.de/projects/liveops/): A backend and a console a game studio runs to watch a live economy, get one bounded change drafted, and approve it with a name and a reason
- [Agent Gateway](https://keremozdemir.de/projects/agent-gateway/): A gateway that AI agents call tools through: an API contract compiled into signed mappings, every call decided by two policy engines before it leaves
- [CoLaunch](https://keremozdemir.de/projects/colaunch/): A platform matching startup ideas with the people who can build them

## Case studies (https://keremozdemir.de/cases/)
- [Discounted cash flow](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/dcf-lab/): A discounted cash flow where the terminal value is not allowed to hide
- [Marginal abatement cost curve](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/marginal-abatement/): An abatement cost curve that prints the arithmetic behind every bar
- [Emissions decomposition](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/carbon-bridge/): Four causes for one change in emissions, with nothing left over
- [Unit conversion](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/unitguard/): A converter that names what is missing instead of guessing it
- [Market sizing](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/market-sizer/): Two sizings and the gap between them
- [Reduction pathway](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/target-path/): A reduction target is one number
- [Data provenance](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/provenance/): A figure that carries its source and keeps carrying it through the arithmetic
- [CBAM embedded emissions](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/embedded/): A single embedded emissions figure hides the one thing an abatement decision needs

## Tools (https://keremozdemir.de/work/workshop/), 9 single-job tools, 466 hand-written checks
- [Dotsheet](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/dotsheet/): Text into Unified English Braille, and the braille back into text, so you can read what it actually says
- [Sheetwise](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/sheetwise/): Puts the pages of a PDF onto press sheets in the order a folded and stitched book needs
- [Cutplan](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/cutplan/): Turns a drawing into instructions for a laser cutter, cutting the holes before the outline so the part does not drop out first
- [Loudmeter](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/loudmeter/): Measures how loud an audio file is against the broadcast standard, and says how much to turn it up or down
- [Cutfill](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/cutfill/): How much earth has to come out and how much has to go in to bring a site to the level you want
- [Cuecheck](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/cuecheck/): Checks a subtitle file against the reading speed and timing rules a broadcaster applies
- [Boardplan](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/boardplan/): Lays parts out on sheet material in cuts a panel saw can actually make
- [Buildup](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/buildup/): The layers of a wall in, how much heat it loses out, to the standard building control asks for
- [Costcurve](https://keremozdemir.de/run/workshop/costcurve/): Ranks emission cuts by what each one costs per tonne, and will not cut more than there is to cut

## Simulations and economics (https://keremozdemir.de/work/simulations/, https://keremozdemir.de/work/economics/)
- Segregation: A runnable Schelling model
- Diffusion: The same contagion at the same transmission probability, run over three network shapes: a lattice, a small world graph and a scale free graph
- Jam: A ring road with nothing blocking it
- Pile: A sandpile driven one grain at a time, organising itself to the edge of stability
- Recommender: A feed that decides what each agent sees, run again against a neutral one on the same population
- Lemons: Adverse selection, run as a used car market
- Incidence: Drag the supply and demand curves, set a tax, and watch the burden split between the two sides
- Discounting: Move the rate and watch a fixed benefit in a distant year lose almost all of its present value
- Cooperation: The repeated prisoner's dilemma

## Instruments (https://keremozdemir.de/work/instruments/)
- CBAM, embedded emissions, reduction pathways, provenance and DCF valuation, each running in the page
